visual_style: warm hand-drawn watercolor illustration; soft volume; not photorealistic; not clay-3D
recommended_display_size: 26x26 pt/px logical (visual asset); 28x28 may be used on larger screens

label.gap_below_icon: 8–10 pt from selected background container to label

implementation_rules: Do not redraw, vectorize, recolor, crop, or add shadows to these icon images.
Use object-fit/contain and preserve the complete transparent canvas.
The selected pale-green rounded rectangle is a separate UI container; it is NOT baked into the PNG.
Use active PNG only for the selected tab and inactive PNG for all other tabs.
Respect the device bottom safe-area inset; do not hard-code the home-indicator spacing.
layout_notes: Selected-state background and label must never touch or visually overlap.
Use 8–10 pt vertical breathing room between the bottom of the 44pt selected container and the label.
Center the icon optically inside the selected container, with a slight 1pt upward optical adjustment if needed.
Keep the label baseline aligned across all four tabs.
Do not reduce the gap to compensate for device safe-area differences; handle safe area below the entire tab bar.
